text: The package spawned curl against the cloud metadata endpoint 169.254.169.254 to enumerate IAM credentials, instance identity and region, and it attempted to send this machine's hostname plus honeytoken AWS, GitHub and npm credentials to a collection host at oastify.com. Those network attempts were answered by a fake internet in the sandbox, so nothing reached a real host and nothing was downloaded, but the rule engine recorded the honeytokens as leaving the sandbox, which is what drives the CRITICAL verdict. This behaves like the recorded attack bitcore-message-zen. Do not merge or install this package, and if it has ever run outside the sandbox, rotate the AWS, GitHub and npm credentials on that machine.
